⚠️ A red conclusion on any of them still counts as a **pass** for this row — the defect was that they published **no check run at all**, which branch protection holds as permanently pending. An absence is what is being tested for, not a failure.

⚠️ Kept a **draft** on purpose, so it cannot be enqueued and does not ask anyone for review. ⚠️ Also expected, and not part of the reading: `Governed Surface Queue Guard` does not run on drafts.
